basic_info.description: 2-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 120% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $143,900; 3 = $161,800; 4 = $179,800, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. The unit will be available on a first come first served basis starting on 12/17/2024 at 8:00 AM PST. Please visit  https://housing.sfgov.org/listings/a0W7y000002eeLlEAI to view the listing and for application & program info. Fair Housing Opportunity.  Waivers available include waiving first-time homebuyer's requirement, household size and more!            This is a wonderful 2 BR loft condo on the top floor. It has great views, vaulted ceilings and large windows which create a bright and airy ambiance, making the space feel even more expansive. The new carpet and fresh paint add a contemporary touch, while the picturesque Diamond Heights neighborhood offers both tranquility and convenience. Being close to parks, shops, restaurants, and cultural attractions ensures a well-rounded lifestyle. It's a great option for anyone looking for a comfortable, stylish home in a desirable area.
